user.title: ZverTBot VPS connection
user.description:
Choose how to connect to the VPS.

Home Assistant → VPS tunnel over SSH — use this option if an SSH tunnel to the VPS is already configured on Home Assistant. The integration uses the existing tunnel and does not require a separate key for a direct connection.

Direct SSH connection — use this option if no SSH tunnel is configured or you want Home Assistant to connect directly to the VPS. You can use an existing SSH key or create a new key specifically for this integration. The key must be accessible to Home Assistant.

tunnel.title: Existing SSH tunnel
tunnel.description: The integration uses the existing Home Assistant tunnel on 127.0.0.1:8080. No new Internet-facing ports are opened.

ssh.title: Direct SSH connection
ssh.description: The connection uses the existing VPS SSH port. Specify the SSH key available to Home Assistant. No new Internet-facing ports are opened.

ssh_key.title: SSH key usage
ssh_key.description: Choose how the SSH key should be used for a direct VPS connection.

ssh_key_create.title: Create SSH key
ssh_key_create.description: A new Ed25519 key will be created inside Home Assistant. The private key will be stored at the selected path and never displayed.

ssh_key_public.title: SSH key created
ssh_key_public.description:
The private key was saved to {key_path}.

Add this public key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys on the VPS:

{public_key}

Then continue to test the connection.

ssh_key_existing.title: Existing SSH key
ssh_key_existing.description: Specify the path to an existing private SSH key inside Home Assistant.
